description: Surface readiness and protection without biometric internals

gnome_changes.view_model: Added ReadinessLevel enum (Ready/NotReady/Unknown), ReadinessView struct (daemon, model, camera, has_enrolled_profiles, enabled_pam_count), ProtectionView struct (label, warning, is_software_fallback, emitter_reduced). Changed PresenterModel.protection from Option<ProtectionStatus> to Option<ProtectionView>. Added readiness: Option<ReadinessView> field. Added serde::Serialize to all nested view types (QualityView, RecoveryHint, ReviewView, EnrollmentView, PendingMerge, PendingReplace, PendingPamToggle, ErrorView, ProtectionStatusView).
gnome_changes.presenter: refresh() now builds ProtectionView from raw ProtectionStatus + emitter_armed flag via ProtectionView::from_status(). Builds ReadinessView from daemon reachability (get_status Ok = Ready), profile count, and enabled PAM service count. Single get_status() call reused for status, emitter_armed, and readiness (was previously called twice).
gnome_changes.wizard: Added 'System Readiness' section rendering daemon/model/camera levels, enrolled profiles, and PAM service count. Updated 'Template Protection' section to use ProtectionView fields (label, is_software_fallback, emitter_reduced, warning) instead of raw ProtectionStatus.
gnome_changes.privacy: Exposed scan_value() as public function so mutation tests can inject forbidden field names into JSON and verify detection.

kde_changes.main_qml: Added 'System Readiness' section: daemon ready/not running, model loaded/unknown, camera detected/not detected, enrolled profiles yes/none, PAM services enabled count (computed from pamServices model). Added emitter-reduced warning label to Template Protection section. Fixed broken Kirigami.Heading for Enrolled Profiles section (was missing body and closing brace).

what_is_shown.daemon_readiness: coarse level: ready / not running / unknown
what_is_shown.model_readiness: coarse level: ready / unknown (inferred from daemon reachability)
what_is_shown.camera_readiness: coarse level: ready / unknown (inferred from daemon reachability)
what_is_shown.tpm_fallback_warning: is_software_fallback boolean + warning text (persistent when software fallback)

privacy_mutation_test.description: For each forbidden substring in FORBIDDEN_SUBSTRINGS, inject it as a field name into a JSON object shaped like ProtectionView and ReadinessView, then assert the scan flags it.
